WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE (d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999) OR (d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999)
),
filtered_store_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, MAX(ss_net_profit) as store_sales_profit
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk
),
filtered_store_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_item_sk, MAX(sr_net_loss) as store_returns_loss
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr_item_sk
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, MAX(cs_net_profit) as catalog_sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
)
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name,
       store_sales_profit, store_returns_loss, catalog_sales_profit
FROM item
JOIN store ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
LEFT JOIN filtered_store_sales ON i_item_sk = filtered_store_sales.ss_item_sk
LEFT JOIN filtered_store_returns ON i_item_sk = filtered_store_returns.sr_item_sk
LEFT JOIN filtered_catalog_sales ON i_item_sk = filtered_catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
